drivingQuestion: From when, and until when, may the morning Shema be recited?
outcomeNote: A mishna: two tannaitic disputes are recorded, R' Eliezer on the starting point and R' Yehoshua on the end point, with no resolution and no gemara in this unit.

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ מֵאֵימָתַי קוֹרִין אֶת שְׁמַע בְּשַׁחֲרִית? מִשֶּׁיַּכִּיר בֵּין תְּכֵלֶת לְלָבָן. רַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר אוֹמֵר: בֵּין תְּכֵלֶת לְכָרָתֵי. וְגוֹמְרָהּ, עַד הָנֵץ הַחַמָּה, רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אוֹמֵר עַד שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁעוֹת, שֶׁכֵּן דֶּרֶךְ מְלָכִים לַעֲמוֹד בְּשָׁלֹשׁ שָׁעוֹת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «From when does one recite Shema in the morning»? «From» when a person «can distinguish between sky-blue [tekhelet] and white.» «Rabbi Eliezer says:» From when one can distinguish «between sky-blue and leek-green.» «And» one must «finish» reciting Shema «until» the end of the period when you rise, i.e., «sunrise,» when the sun begins to shine. «Rabbi Yehoshua says:» One may recite the morning Shema «until three hours» of the day, which this is still considered when you rise, «as that is the habit of kings to rise» from their sleep «at three hours» of the day.

segments.he: הַקּוֹרֵא מִכָּאן וְאֵילָךְ — לֹא הִפְסִיד, כְּאָדָם הַקּוֹרֵא בַּתּוֹרָה.
segments.en: While there is a set time frame for the recitation of Shema, «one who recites» Shema «from that time onward loses nothing.» Although he does not fulfill the mitzva of reciting of Shema at its appointed time, «he is» nevertheless considered «like one who reads the Torah,» and is rewarded accordingly.
